scope: 2026 full-year resident domestic salary and non-loss-making ordinary business national income/reconstruction tax only
confirmed: Annual salary/basic deduction reform effective 2026-12-01, applicable to 2026 annual income; earlier withholding and early death/departure returns excluded.

Salary table: under741000 gives zero; 741000-2190999 subtract740000; three special intervals at2191000/2193000/2196000; from2200000 to6599999 use4000-yen gross steps with70%/80% less80000/440000; 6600000-8499999 use90% less1100000 and truncate fractions; above that subtract1950000.
Eligible child/special-disability salary adjustment: capped gross10000000 less8500000 times10%, round up to1yen; apply before total-income/basic-deduction test.
Taxable income truncated to1000yen; ordinary national seven-band schedule; verified limited non-refundable income-tax credits precede2.1% reconstruction tax, truncated to1yen.

Withholding deducted before positive declared-tax truncation to100yen; negative refund keeps yen. Effective notified estimated-tax liability deducted afterward, irrespective of cash payment; arrears are separate.
NTA1000 official2026 business example: national tax63302, declared payment63300. Official salary example: salary income4360000, taxable2360000, income tax138500, reconstruction2908, refund34692.
extraction_notes: NTA114 PDF contains obsolete/garbled hidden heading text; rendered first and last pages identify2026. Use visible current numeric table, not hidden2009 heading.
All1103 fixed-output intervals independently extracted from originalPDF; tests check both ends against calculator. Low-income linear and high-income formula regions separately tested.
NTA r08/zeigakuhyo.pdf is an estimated-tax-reduction reference retaining pre-December deduction table; it was not adopted as annual2026 deduction authority.
NTA2025 return guide used only for settlement procedure, corroborated by reviewed ITA104/120 and NTA1000 2026 examples; its annual deductions/rates not reused.
exclusions_and_remaining: Japanese company income tax, local inhabitant/enterprise taxes, full foreign/dividend integration remain outstanding.
Pensions, special/separate-rate income, losses/carry-forwards, blue-return relief, specific employment expenses and high-income minimum-tax comparison are excluded from this adapter.
Deduction eligibility and credit caps must be established before using verified aggregate inputs; these entitlements are not automatically adjudicated.
No claim of full original-document review, cloud source admission, production deployment or final branch transfer.
New originals are registered in doc.csv; regenerated clause/files/SQLite indexes and cloud admission remain pending.
